messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for service=rt-inference (canary: us-west2). release=v2026.3.2. Kicking off post-deploy smoke-suite: synth-sampler, prefills, kv-warmup, quick traces.

irene: seeing synth-sampler ingest ~=300/min vs baseline ~1200/min. p95 latency unchanged but coverage low. graphs: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/synth-ingest :eyes:

sam: on it. grabbing logs from synth-sampler-canary pod. noticed pod restart at 11:03:12 with OOMKilled. link: https://logs/redwood/xyz

sam: restarting sampler pod now: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/synth-sampler-canary`

jia: also seeing metrics.ingest.delay spike ~+90s around the same window. could be backpressure in the pipeline. dashboard snapshot: https://grafana/redwood/d/ingest/lag

leo: user-facing KPIs (5xx, latency) show no regression. seems internal to synthetic pipeline. my vote: do NOT rollback, hold promotion of canary->prod for now. :thinking_face:

irene: agree. hold next wave. run manual replay of missed samples to rebuild prefix/KV cache per runbook step 3. Command: `scripts/replay_synth.sh --from=2026-03-21T11:45Z --to=2026-03-21T11:55Z --concurrency=4`

sam: starting replay (job id replay-3412). tail logs: `replay: enqueued 9.8k events, paced at 200/s`

sam: replay complete. sampler ingest now ~1150/min, metrics lag down to normal. verified prefills: 180/180 ok (canary).

deploy-bot: smoke-suite results: prefills 180/180 PASS, kv-warmup hit-rate 93% (target >=90%), tail p95 within SLO.

jia: opened SRE-783 to track root cause (OOM on sampler). added heap-pressure dashboard and liveness tweaks.

irene: moving to green. schedule promote wave at +15m. update release notes: brief note about transient synth undercount and remediation.

leo: release notes line: "post-deploy: transient synthetic-sampler undercount observed during canary due to sampler restart; samples replayed and prefills verified. No customer-facing impact; follow-up SRE ticket SRE-783."

sam: follow-up: bumped sampler memory request by +256Mi and adjusted liveness probe threshold. will ship as hotfix next patch.

irene: thanks. tagging @oncall to FYI. :thumbsup:

leo: leaving this thread — added checkpoint to the release checklist: verify synth sample rate >= 80% of baseline before promotion.

sam: closing replay job and archiving logs to s3://redwood-archives/replays/replay-3412.tar.gz

irene: moving forward with promote at 11:42Z. all good.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled: wave=prod-1 at 11:57Z. Notification will follow. :white_check_mark:
